Definition: from G2596 and the neuter plural of G3739; according to which things, i.e. just as:--as.
BiblicalUsage: They gave the thirty pieces of silver for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the blood money was counted in prophecy, and nothing about the betrayal surprised God.
